## Type of change

- [ ] `fix:` bug fix (dashboard layout, script error, broken link)
- [ ] `feat:` new user-facing feature
- [ ] `docs:` README / changelog / release notes only
- [ ] `ci:` pipeline or validation change
- [ ] `chore:` tooling, metadata, templates
- [ ] `refactor:` internal cleanup with no behavior change

## Scope

- [ ] `index.html` (dashboard)
- [ ] `assets/` (screenshot, banner, social preview)
- [ ] `.github/` (CI, templates)
- [ ] Docs / release notes
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

> **Never edit `data.json` by hand.** It is generated by the bot's sync pipeline and
> committed automatically every ~15 minutes. Changes to it are overwritten.

## Checks

- [ ] `data.json` still parses and contains `generated_at`, `account`, `stats_all`, `equity_snapshots`, `trades`
- [ ] `index.html` still loads `data.json` correctly (tested with a local static server)
- [ ] `schema.sql` untouched, or the schema change is described above
- [ ] CI is green (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`)
- [ ] Release notes / `CHANGELOG.md` updated if this is a user-visible release

## Safety & legal

- [ ] No secrets, API keys, tokens, or private keys are added.
- [ ] No account numbers, login, server names, investor passwords or broker credentials are added.
- [ ] The **"not financial advice"** disclaimer and the "auto-generated, one personal account" attribution are intact in the README and dashboard.
- [ ] Screenshots contain no identifying account data.
